title: Reproducibility package for a physics-deep learning daily drought forecasting framework
description: Code, processed daily station data, station-matched CMIP6 auxiliary training contexts, curated manuscript table/figure data, full prediction tables, and model checkpoints for a physics-deep learning hybrid framework for daily drought-index and flash-drought early-risk forecasting. The package covers the eight-station Jinsha River Basin main experiment and a 16-station Upper Yellow River Basin external validation with both zero-shot transfer and local recalibration protocols.
